uranus-trine-ascendant: You carry a natural originality; novelty sits easily on you. People see you as free.
uranus-opposition-ascendant: Your Uranus is on the Descendant: you attract unconventional, free-spirited partners; relationships change you and wake you up. The balance between closeness and space is something to build together.
neptune-conjunction-ascendant: You have a mysterious, soft, fluid presence; people see in you whatever they want to see. Setting boundaries is how you protect yourself.
neptune-sextile-ascendant: You leave an intuitive, compassionate first impression; people trust you and open up. Your softness isn't weakness; it's your strength.
neptune-square-ascendant: You may deal with a blurry sense of identity and being misperceived; a tendency to escape shows up. Once you get clear, your intuition becomes a strength.
neptune-trine-ascendant: You carry a natural intuition and grace; you have an artistic air. People soften and relax around you.
neptune-opposition-ascendant: Your Neptune is on the Descendant: romance and idealism run strong in your relationships; you may tend to put a partner on a pedestal and dissolve into them, or play the rescuer. Protecting your boundaries doesn't break the spell; it makes it last.
pluto-conjunction-ascendant: You have an intense, powerful, transformative presence; people notice you right away. Control is your shadow; depth is your strength.
pluto-sextile-ascendant: You leave a powerful, deep first impression; you have a striking presence. People don't forget you easily.
pluto-square-ascendant: Power struggles and intensity can make first impressions tough; you may intimidate people. When you soften your power, your influence grows even more.
pluto-trine-ascendant: You carry a natural power and depth; you have a transformative presence. People change around you without realizing it.
pluto-opposition-ascendant: Your Pluto is on the Descendant: relationships are deep, intense and transformative; you attract powerful partners. When you learn to share power, the bond becomes a rebirth.
